name: Todoist
tagline: Todoist is a clean, cross-platform task manager used by over 42 million people to organise personal and professional to-do lists. Its AI assistant converts vague tasks like 'write the report by Friday morning' into scheduled, prioritised items automatically. Power users appreciate Todoist's natural-language input, karma system, and integrations with calendar apps and communication tools.
